messages.subject: Larger sizes?
messages.text:
First off, Huzzah! Your mission is deeply admirable and ingenious. Hoping the word gets out and you exceed all your expectations for success in all aspects of this brilliant endeavor. 

 But second, alas! Large humans need larger sizes for things such as insoles and mittens. Also hoping you folks consider producing things for big heads, feet and hands. Us big folk have needs (and cash money) that could help expand your range of customers (and exposure).
 

 Good work!
 

 Sleepy Bear
 Michigan

messages.subject: Re: Larger sizes?
messages.text:
Thank you so much for your kind words and support! We are thrilled to hear from you and appreciate your suggestions regarding our size range. We understand the importance of catering to all body sizes and are actively working to expand our product line to include larger sizes for insoles, mittens, and other items. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we are excited to explore this opportunity to serve a broader audience. We'll keep you updated on our progress and hope to meet your needs in the near future. Thanks again for reaching out and for your enthusiasm about our mission!
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay
